comments.value: I’m currently having this issue too if it’s what I think it is :/ (made a post about it). like some avatars will load, but newer ones that my friends switch into will be the error robot.
Hello! Thanks for reporting this.  Do you have any content filters active?  Can you provide a screenshot or video of this issue?

@{64873f159cf028090ce2c2e2|full_name}: Hello! This happens even without having a full body, there are some or even all avatars! When you try to load, the ERROR avatar appears. Same for the worlds, it takes you home :/ (It's been since the last patch of the year!)

@{64873f159cf028090ce2c2e2|full_name}: Here is the bug demonstration video for worlds, which I sent in #open-beta-discussion on discord!

And no filters! activated (apart from the avatar)

And here is the bug that prevents me from seeing the avatars, it puts me in error robot mode

-> https://youtu.be/jZMXu2Zr2RM <-> For the worlds

EDIT : I updated my NVIDIA graphics card and it worked again for avatars and worlds, a bit strange actually....
@{63646316325a845c18557e8b|full_name}: Just want to confirm, you no longer have issues after updating your graphics card?
@{636aa1f8cf0d393a70b464c6|full_name}: We just had a few updates go out to Open Beta.  Is this issue still occurring for you?

@{64873f159cf028090ce2c2e2|full_name}: After long hours, I still have bugs despite updating my graphics card driver, whether for the worlds or for the avatars.

and always the same bugs for the worlds, of which it is the same for the video on the world that I put above

(Here's what it does when you can't load the avatar)

-> https://youtu.be/gZjMn50zFeA?si=clQIfJNLfB8ZgJSn
@{63646316325a845c18557e8b|full_name}: Thanks for the info, this helps.  Could you provide one (or more) avatar IDs that are showing error robots so we can take a look?

@{64873f159cf028090ce2c2e2|full_name}: I've had my avatar for about 1 year, and it's still this one, and if I manage to join a world, if there are for example 20 players, it's basically everyone who is in avatar robot error

((and also, if I want to see an avatar, I have to force the show avatar, and spam between deshow and show avatar :/)

But here is my avatar ID, but it has never done this to me before....

-> avtr_19f259c2-c4d8-482d-b73a-294541e3500c
@{63646316325a845c18557e8b|full_name}: Do you have any logs from when this happened?
@{64873f159cf028090ce2c2e2|full_name}: he does it all the time. apart from in VR on my other PC where it does nothing... but many of my friends have this problem and it persists all the time.

@{64873f159cf028090ce2c2e2|full_name}: I just checked on desktop on my PC for VR, it works perfectly, but not on the usual PC... and I'm not the only one to complain about that, quite strange....

EDIT : I just tested in LAN (Ethernet) mode, it does absolutely the same thing... :/

@{63646316325a845c18557e8b|full_name}: To get logs:

1. Open your Quick Menu

2. Select the settings tab

3. Scroll to the bottom under Debug

4. Switch Logging to On

5. After you encounter the avatar loading issue check this folder for the log: C:\Users\%Username%\AppData\LocalLow\VRChat\vrchat named output_log. txt.

@{64873f159cf028090ce2c2e2|full_name}: 

I am providing you with the logs, because I have absolutely no understanding of what is marked in them ^^'

--> https://we.tl/t-eiP1vUkrob

@{64873f159cf028090ce2c2e2|full_name} Hi ! There is an open beta update but it does not fix the 2 bugs ;(

When will it be resolved?

Thank you for your answers!
@{63646316325a845c18557e8b|full_name}: The issue is known, but I can't provide a status or timeline currently.  I actually hit this bug myself recently, so I was able to pass on some additional info.
@{64873f159cf028090ce2c2e2|full_name} Okay, thank you very much for your answers :)
@{64873f159cf028090ce2c2e2|full_name}I probably an IPv6 problem
@{64873f159cf028090ce2c2e2|full_name} It's a problem I confirm, it doesn't accept IPV6, I just removed it and it works again!

MUST READ! : If you want to get around the bugs, you must deactivate IPv6 on your computer, for that

1. In the Windows search bar, type “Show network connections”

2. Right click on your computer's ethernet or wifi.

2. and click Properties.

3. and Disable “Internet driver version 6”

4. The bug is no longer visible on vrchat! good game
@{64873f159cf028090ce2c2e2|full_name} A beta update has just been launched. And if I understood correctly, correct a lot of things, and certainly, my concern, but nothing changes. I might be wrong.

@{63646316325a845c18557e8b|full_name}

As Microsoft not recommend disable IPv6 as some site only support IPv6 traffic which may cause issue.

Try following command in elevated command promt which priolitize IPv4 than IPv6 could archive same result.

```

netsh interface ipv6 set prefixpolicy ::ffff:0:0/96 100 4

```

if you want to reset

```

netsh interface ipv6 reset

```
@{5ce09c4ff1ef661188867ab5|full_name} After several days, the problem returns :/ A fix is ​​better suited
@{63646316325a845c18557e8b|full_name}oh....also good to try other DNS server be option too.

@{5ce09c4ff1ef661188867ab5|full_name} 

No other DNS server works, VRChat spits out all ipv6 DNS :/
